dedupe_keys.name: mopo an open pan european energy system planning framework using spine tools baseline scenario

description: EPRI Europe DAC and Alvaro Porras publish, for the Horizon Europe MOPO project, a pan-European energy-system planning model and its baseline scenario. The native description says that the repository supports analysis and reproduction of integrated planning and supplies a reference for comparing policies, technologies and future pathways. It explicitly requires Spine Toolbox version 0.10.5 and SpineOpt version 0.11 and links the separate MOPO pan-European input dataset. This record covers the configured baseline model, while the related SpineOpt and Spine Toolbox records represent general software. Zenodo provides an openly accessible model deposit under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Coverage is pan-European; exact model zones, baseline calendar year, scenario horizon and numerical results are not enumerated in this model’s description. A limitation is that the package was not opened or executed, so configuration completeness, installed dependencies and reproducibility remain unverified.
